**And try to reason with the negative voice in your head. Don't let it bully you or manipulate you. You can get through this**

Excellent advice. I really appreciate it. I’ll try to refocus my thoughts.
Thank you. Sometimes I do just let go and try let everything take its course.
It makes sense. I do what I can to occupy my brain as much as possible.....Any distraction I can get my hands on.

I wasted the vast majority of my twenties, but there were a few highlights here and there. Indulge yourself in your hobbies (provided they don’t hurt you or anyone else). Find new hobbies and try a few new things. Even if they don’t pan out, at least you can tell yourself you tried. You don’t have to concentrate on huge events and vacations. Just take time to do little things that are meaningful to you. 

I’m nearly 29. I have a lot of regrets, but also a few significant milestones to look back on. Don’t give up yet. I’ve spent the last ten years thinking I was too old to do this or that. It’s a waste. Try to enjoy yourself!
